name: Misbehavior-Bench
description:
Misbehavior-Bench
	

Misbehavior-Bench is the official benchmark dataset for the ICLR 2026 paper Detecting Misbehaviors of Large Vision-Language Models by Evidential Uncertainty Quantification.
This benchmark provides a comprehensive suite of evaluation scenarios designed to characterize four distinct categories of Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) misbehaviors: Hallucination, Jailbreak, Adversarial Attacks, and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Failures. It serves as a foundational resource… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerryHWong/Misbehavior-Bench.
evaluation_method: accuracy / F1 / AUROC (detection and classification metrics)
general_score_metric: composite detection metric (F1 or AUROC depending on subtask)
reputation: A new, research-oriented benchmark introduced for ICLR 2026 with growing interest from LVLM safety researchers but limited adoption so far.
